title: Verify: BootScene plays the authored transition on create
description: Add a test file frontend/tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts mocking phaser, @game/engine/buildEffects and ../src/phaser/effectContext.
acceptance_criteria: create() calls the context playTransition with the content duration
No call when the scene has no transition
technical_constraints: Follow the phaser mock in frontend/tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts; mock ../src/runtime/content to supply the scene

steps.action: Create the test: vi.mock phaser as in bootSceneEffects.test.ts; vi.mock '@game/engine/buildEffects' returning []; vi.mock '../src/phaser/effectContext' so createPhaserEffectContext returns {createEffect: vi.fn(), playTransition} with a shared playTransition vi.fn; set the store state via createInitialState(world, scene). Test 1 'fades with the bundled scene duration': call new BootScene().create(); expect playTransition toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) and toHaveBeenCalledWith(400) (the bedroom.yaml duration, read from scene.effects). Test 2 'no fade without a transition entry': vi.mock '../src/runtime/content' with a scene whose effects omit the transition (use vi.doMock plus dynamic import of BootScene) and expect playTransition not called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransition.test.ts
